en.failure: Original3D had flat strip-like attachments; tested atlas alternative did not demonstrate epididymal body/tail.
en.cause: Useful labels and source pedigree do not establish visible anatomical completeness.
en.fix: Original2D sectional relationship aid, explicitly symbolic; no invented3D source anatomy.
en.retest: ActualEN/ZH images reviewed; capsule leader and Chinese spacing corrected; final outlinedSVG renders match preview pixels in isolated replay.
en.lesson: When source geometry cannot support detail, teach verified relationships explicitly instead of polishing an incomplete shape into an apparent pass.

zh.fix: 原创2D剖面关系教学图，明确标注示意；不臆造3D来源解剖。
